title: Imam Bayildi Stuffed Eggplant

seo.imageCaption: Enjoy this flavorful and authentic Imam Bayildi, a classic Turkish vegetarian delight.

description: Imam Bayildi, meaning "the Imam fainted," is a classic Turkish dish featuring whole eggplants generously stuffed with a savory mixture of onions, tomatoes, garlic, and fresh herbs. Slowly baked until tender, this vegetarian delight bursts with Mediterranean flavors, making it a beloved staple of Turkish cuisine. It's a perfect example of rich, plant-based Ottoman tradition.

instructions.title: Prepare the Eggplants
instructions.text: Wash the eggplants and peel them in alternating stripes. Make a deep slit lengthwise down each eggplant, being careful not to cut all the way through. Sprinkle generously with salt and let them sit for 20 minutes to draw out bitterness. Rinse thoroughly under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.

instructions.title: Sauté the Aromatics
instructions.text: Heat 1/4 cup of olive oil in a large skillet or pan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onions and cook until softened and translucent, about 8-10 minutes. Add the minced garlic and finely diced green bell pepper, cooking for another 3-4 minutes until fragrant.

instructions.title: Create the Flavorful Filling
instructions.text: Stir in the diced tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, salt, and black pepper into the skillet. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the tomatoes soften and the mixture thickens slightly. Remove the pan from heat and gently stir in the fresh chopped parsley and mint.

instructions.title: Stuff the Eggplants
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F). Gently open the slits in the dried eggplants. Spoon the prepared savory filling generously into each eggplant. Arrange the stuffed eggplants neatly in a baking dish, ensuring they fit snugly.

instructions.title: Bake the Imam Bayildi
instructions.text: Carefully pour 1 cup of hot water into the bottom of the baking dish, taking care not to wash off the stuffing. Drizzle the remaining 1/4 cup of olive oil over the stuffed eggplants. Cover the baking dish tightly with aluminum foil.

instructions.title: Finish and Serve
instructions.text: Bake for 30-35 minutes with the foil on. Then, remove the foil and continue baking for another 10-15 minutes, or until the eggplants are very tender and the top is slightly browned and caramelized. Serve warm or at room temperature, garnished with extra fresh parsley or a dollop of plain yogurt.

tips: Always salt your eggplants and let them rest to remove bitterness, then rinse thoroughly. This step is crucial for authentic Turkish eggplant dishes.
For an extra rich flavor, you can lightly pan-fry the salted and dried eggplants in a little olive oil before stuffing and baking.
Imam Bayildi is traditionally served at room temperature or slightly warm. It tastes even better the next day, allowing the flavors to meld beautifully.
